b_01KXAJDTNFVEE7ZD0845ERCVDA.content: Per Addition rules, the LVL beam to open the existing load-bearing wall is a retrofit sub-chain that runs in parallel with new exterior framing and should not gate new-construction sequencing unless the new addition's structural load bears directly on that LVL location.
b_01KXAJDTNFVEE7ZD0845ERCVDA.falsification_test: Engineering review confirms the addition's roof or floor load bears on the LVL location, requiring it to complete before new framing begins.

b_01KXAJDTNF5YB8WCSMFGK7QW2P.content: The 3/12-to-6/12 pitch transition is a concealed-condition risk per Addition rules; a 2–3 day discovery buffer should be built into the schedule immediately after the tie-in area is opened.
